title: How to Test If It’s God’s Voice: The 4-Filter Method
hook: Hearing God or just your thoughts? Use these 4 filters to know the difference.
script: Hearing God or just your thoughts? Use these 4 filters to know the difference. First, Scripture: God’s voice never contradicts the Bible. If it pulls you toward holiness, truth, and love, that aligns (2 Timothy 3:16). Second, Christlike fruit: real wisdom is pure, peaceable, gentle, and produces love, joy, and self-control (Galatians 5:22–23; James 3:17). Third, wise counsel: invite mature believers to weigh in; there is safety in a multitude of counselors (Proverbs 11:14). Fourth, peace and providence: let Christ’s peace rule in your heart as God opens or closes doors (Colossians 3:15). Breathe, ask, listen: Lord, lead me by Your Word, Your fruit, Your people, and Your peace.

title: The 60-Second Journal to Discern God’s Voice
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: If God feels silent right now, watch this. Take 60 seconds and open a fresh note. Write the impression you’re weighing. Now test it with four lines. Scripture: which verses support or challenge this? Write one truth you know God already said. Fruit: if you obeyed, would it grow love, joy, peace, and gentleness—or anxiety, envy, and pride? Counsel: name two wise, godly people you’ll ask today. Peace and providence: do you sense Christ’s peace, and are doors opening or closing? End with this prayer: Jesus, let Your peace be the umpire in my heart as I follow Your Word.

title: A Real-Life 4-Filter Decision Story
script: You may be overthinking this. My friend had two job offers. Anxiety was loud, so he ran them through the 4 filters. Scripture: one role required cutting corners—didn’t match truth or integrity, so no. Fruit: the other stirred peace, patience, and a desire to serve, not ego. Counsel: his mentor and small group prayed and confirmed the same direction. Peace and providence: an unexpected email extended the timeline and favor for that offer, and Christ’s peace settled in his heart. He chose it. Not perfect, but steady. Try it today: Word, fruit, counsel, peace. God isn’t confusing; He’s guiding.
